title: ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail

ItemRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Item. When a line lacks an ItemRef it will be treated as "documentation" and the Amount will be ignored.

ClassRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Class for the line item.

UnitPrice.description: Product: ALL Description: Unit price of the service or item for the line.

UnitCostPrice.description: Product: ALL Description: cost rate of the service or item for the line of Project Estimate.

RatePercent.description: Product: ALL Description: The amount is expressed as a percent of charges already entered in the current transaction. To enter a rate of 10% use 10.0, not 0.01.

PriceLevelRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the PriceLevel of the service or item for the line.

MarkupInfo.description: Product: ALL Description: Markup information for the Item wherever applicable.

Qty.description: Product: ALL Description: Number of items for the line.

UOMRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the UOMSetREf (unit of mesasure set) that applies to this item.

ItemAccountRef.description: Product: ALL Description: An account different than the account associated with the Item in the current transaction line. Cannot be updated or modified.

InventorySiteRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the InventorySite where this item is located.

TaxCodeRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the SalesTaxCode for this item.

TaxClassificationRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the SalesTaxCode for this item.

CustomerRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Customer associated with the expense.

BillableStatus.description: Product: ALL Description: The billable status of the expense.[br /]

TaxInclusiveAmt.description: Product: QBO Description: Indicates the total amount of line item including tax.

ItemBasedExpenseLineDetailEx.description: Product: ALL Description: Internal use only: extension place holder for ExpenseItemDetail

description: Product: ALL Description: Item based expense detail for a transaction line.
